test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In India, the _______ governs the provisions for bills of exchange.
solution:
The correct answer is** Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881:**

 
 
• This Act specifically deals with negotiable instruments such as bills of exchange, promissory notes, and cheques.
 
• It lays down the legal framework for the creation, transfer, and enforcement of these instruments.
 
• The Act ensures that the holder of such instruments has a clear legal right to recover the amount due.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Companies Act, 2013:**

 
 
• This Act primarily governs the incorporation, regulation, and dissolution of companies in India.
 
• It does not deal with the provisions for bills of exchange, which are covered under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881.
 
 
 
• **Partnership Act, 1932:**
 
 
• This Act governs the formation, operation, and dissolution of partnerships in India.
 
• It does not address the legal framework for negotiable instruments like bills of exchange.
 
 
 
• **Income Tax Act, 1961:**
 
 
• This Act deals with the taxation of income in India.
 
• It does not cover the provisions for negotiable instruments such as bills of exchange.
